cpu_reference.measured_on: an Apple M5 with two threads
cpu_reference.note: Measured 2026-09-25: batch 1, FP32, torch 2.14 eager. An independent measurement on an AWS c7i.xlarge (4 vCPU, PyTorch 2.8 eager, FP32) puts resnet50 at 224 px at about 44 ms (https://towardsdatascience.com/optimizing-pytorch-model-inference-on-cpu/, 2025-12-08), within 12% of the 49.8 ms here, which is why these numbers stand in for a 2-vCPU box until one is measured. Table rows are the slowest single-row predict per estimator family over laptop_price, mobile_price, heart_risk and adult_income, scikit-learn 1.8.0, two threads.
